integrationGate: Lead release of stage-B source ownership after homepage publication

content.displayTextPolicy: Resolve segmentIds directly from content. Do not copy, normalize, add, omit or reorder text/pinyin.

geometryContract.units: CSS px; cx is fraction of current scene width; x = width*cx + dxPx - widthPx/2
geometryContract.legacyLayout: legacy-demo uses the accepted chapter-1 implementation, not these new profiles
geometryContract.propDock: x = dock center x + dxPx - prop width/2; y = dock top + dock height/2 + dyPx - prop height/2. Null width/height inherit dock dimensions.
geometryContract.scenePositioning: Position only scene layers; text and controls stay in normal flow. Never scale the whole UI.
geometryContract.motionWrapper: All WAAPI effects target an inner motion wrapper; static placement and SVG geometry use separate outer layers. SVG parts use transform-box:fill-box.

audioContract.readingGroupPlayback: For a readingGroup: lead all segmentIds in order, then pre-mixed children follow the same segmentIds in order; one Audio element.
audioContract.attributionPolicy: Keep attribution with following speech in the same page and readingGroup; reuse identical approved attribution clips only via the media manifest.
audioContract.missingMedia: Design preview may render static content; public ready/playback must wait for real clips and timings. No placeholder audio, speechSynthesis or generation.
audioContract.timingTextPolicy: Word timings and HD aliases map to original segmentId/character index. Punctuation remains in content.

interactionContract.propBindings: Create one real button only for a visible bound prop on the current page; all unbound props/parts stay decorative. Use the complete placement rectangle as its hit target, expanded only when explicitly safe.
interactionContract.ariaNames: Use existing control vocabulary plus referenced original text; no new visible labels.
interactionContract.readingGroupActivation: Cancel prior run -> play lead then follow -> execute onReadCompleteCueId only if the run is current. No cue on cancelled or missing-media playback.
interactionContract.characterActivation: Elephant reads current page groups in order; a child reads the selected current-page group in its own approved voice. Use defaultReadingGroupId if none is selected; chapter 1 overrides preserve bunny/cat/dog sentence assignments.
interactionContract.manualPageChange: Cancel old media/waits/actions, show target page in free/ready state, never auto-resume cancelled playback.
interactionContract.progress: Only real completed read groups affect progress; prop clicks/actions are not completion shortcuts.
interactionContract.pageFocus: Manual arrows preserve meaningful focus; do not make decorations focusable. Use existing icon controls; previous/next 48x48 minimum, 12px gap.

motionContract.sequence: Cue steps are sequential; tracks in one step animate parts of one prop (or one character) together. No overlapping focal objects.
motionContract.start: Only after the bound read group finishes successfully; no ambient loops or automatic scene animation on page load.
motionContract.completion: If runId is current, apply final transform/opacity to the inner wrapper, cancel the finished WAAPI handle and remove it from the registry.
motionContract.onCancel: Invalidate runId; stop shared Audio, waits and queued cue steps; cancel WAAPI; reset scene part styles to base; clear transient focus; preserve actual completed progress.
motionContract.onPause: Freeze shared Audio, waits and all WAAPI; visibility hidden pauses and never auto-resumes by itself.
motionContract.reducedMotion: No translate/rotate/scale. Apply final opacity only or retain static base transform; preserve audio, input targets and completed content.
motionContract.scope: New scene/prop cues; preserve chapter 1 legacy actions.
motionContract.reducedMotionChange: Cancel active and queued scene cues, reset transforms to static base, preserve the current Audio/read run and progress; subsequent cues use the reduced-motion branch.

chapters.integration: preserve-existing-demo-layout-and-actions; add missing attribution only after homepage release
